Header: Ophiomyia phaseoli , O. spencerella and O. centrocematis Kantchentche ka m'nyemba

Prevention: In the cool, wet and high altitude areas e.g.
Misuku, Nyika, Viphya, Dedza, Ntcheu and
Highlands, early planting in the rainy season (November to
Chitipa, Rumphi, Kasungu, Mzimba, Lilongwe, Zomba and
Supply enough water in irrigated crops for root growth above damaged area.
Apply organic manure to improve soil fertility, which improves the ability of plants to withstand damage.
Earthing up to help damaged plants establish secondary roots.
Bean seeds can be purchased ready- treated with chemical pesticides (see yellow control column).
Monitoring: Additional relevant crops: cowpea, soybean and pigeon pea.
Look for tiny flies with black bodies and shiny wings resting on hypocotyl (first leaves) and/or leaves immediately after plant emergence.
Look for white maggots and brown/black pupae under stem tissue at base of plant, infested tissue has a brown colouration.
Also look for oviposition marks where the flies have laid their eggs on the leaves.
Consider control when 5-10% plants have been infested in the garden.
Direct Control: Earth-up the infested plants to stop the stems from falling over and encourage root development above the damaged tissue.
Uproot and burn withered and dead infested plants to kill the larvae and pupae.
Spray an aqueous neem mixture prepared from 100g of dried neem leaves soaked in 1 liter of warm water (30°C) kept for 2 hrs and filtered.
Restrictions: Use personal protective equipment when handling and applying pesticides, follow the label recommendations.
Do not eat, drink, smoke when mixing or applying pesticides.
Insecticide treated seed is available but can only and purchased from registered companies (Imidacloprid + Pencycuron)
Confidor 70WG, Themethoxam 350g/l (cruiser 350FS) and belong to neonicotinoid group.
Do not store treated seed near food stuffs or where likely prove to be hazardous to human or animals.
Apply full cover spray 3 and 7 days after crop emergence, then weekly interval until blossom.
Apply a maximum of 2 applications per season, Observe a pre- harvest interval (PHI) of 14 days
